name: InterContinental Hayman Island Resort
positioning: Private-island beach resort, officially InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef, at the northern tip of the Whitsundays, with a saltwater pool, a Coral Sea infinity pool, and helicopter flights over Heart Reef
best_for: Travelers who want a beach and pool resort on its own island in the Whitsundays
Families or groups of friends who want a hillside residence with panoramic views
Guests who want to see Heart Reef and Whitehaven Beach from the air

facts.text: Hayman Island sits at the northernmost point of the Whitsunday archipelago in Australia.
The Hayman Pool is the largest saltwater pool in the southern hemisphere.
The Infinity Pool overlooks the Coral Sea.
Poolside Cabanas near the Infinity Pool and Hayman Pool offer ocean views and sundeck space.
The Hayman Residences on the island hillside were designed by Australian architect Kerry Hill and offer panoramic views across the Whitsundays.
Accommodation ranges across rooms, suites, pavilions, villas, residences and the three-bedroom Hayman Beach House.
Hayman Spa has treatment rooms, a couples' room, and sauna and steam facilities set in the natural surrounds of Hayman Island.
The resort offers helicopter adventures over Heart Reef and helicopter tours over Whitehaven Beach.
Guests can travel by resort speedboat to Langford Island, where a sand spit at low tide gives access to fringing coral reefs.
Pacific, the resort's signature restaurant and bar, is on the beachfront in the Central Lanai.
The fitness centre has a dedicated group fitness area offering Pilates, yoga and meditation classes.
Children's activities are offered on site.

highlights.text: The Hayman Pool is the largest saltwater pool in the southern hemisphere.
Hillside Hayman Residences designed by Australian architect Kerry Hill look out across the Whitsundays.
Helicopter adventures fly guests over Heart Reef and Whitehaven Beach.
The Infinity Pool overlooks the Coral Sea.
Hayman Spa has a couples' room, sauna and steam facilities set in the island's natural surrounds.

considerations.text: The resort is in a national park, so pets are not permitted; guide dogs and service animals are exempt.
The nearest airport is Hamilton Island - Great Barrier Reef Airport, about 35 kilometers from the resort.
